instructions.objective:
Navigate to http://localhost:4400/__ap/frame?profile=phone-320&run=r7-phone-320__checkout&start=%2F%23shop then You are testing a web app inside the AspectProof harness, which shows the app at "Phone 320×568 (small Android)".
The page has the app inside a device frame on the left and an "AspectProof layout" panel on the right.
Interact only with the app, the way a real user on this screen size would.
Do not resize the window and do not interact with the panel.
Add 'Trail Runner Shoes' to the cart.
Then open the cart using the site's header navigation (open the Menu button first if the links are not visible).
Change its quantity to 2, press 'Place order', and confirm an 'Order confirmed' message appears.
